description: When you first sent me to the Gold Dome, I made you a promise — to show up, to stand up, and to never forget who sent me. Two sessions later, I want to sit down with you, neighbor to neighbor, and tell you what that promise turned into.Because this work was never about headlines. It's about the grandmother in Fulton County who can stay in the home where she raised her children. It's about the foster child whose services were cut off — and then restored. It's about the kindergartner in South Fult

title: The Work We Did Together: A 2025–2026 Legislative Recap
